name: Morning Brief
problem: Daily brief of top 2 international news (Reuters) and top 2 Swedish news (Sveriges Radio sr.se), written in Mark Twain's voice and drafted as an email to jesper@otrobonita.com

agent.instructions_summary: Fetch top 2 international stories from Reuters and top 2 Swedish stories from sr.se (today/yesterday), write a Mark Twain-voiced brief, draft as a complete email (subject + body) to jesper@otrobonita.com, write to /mnt/session/outputs/

rubric_criteria: Exactly 2 international stories sourced from Reuters
Exactly 2 Swedish stories sourced from Sveriges Radio (sr.se)
All 4 stories are from today or yesterday relative to run date
Tone reads as Mark Twain: sardonic, 19th-century analogy applied to modern events, not neutral/corporate
Output is a complete drafted email with subject line and body addressed to jesper@otrobonita.com

email.next_direction: Wire real email-sending connector (e.g. Gmail/SMTP) in v1 once credential is available
